metadata.title: HDBLAST: Massive de Sitter Quantum Sources and Classical Shell Susceptibility
metadata.description:
This computational checkpoint constructs one-loop vacuum stress and a paired scalar source for a free, minimally coupled massive scalar in the Euclidean/Bunch–Davies de Sitter state, in an explicitly declared fixed-reference finite-action convention. Four registered source points pass 57 primary gates and three negative controls. A separate proper-time implementation agrees, and a separate exact-mode calculation directly checks energy, pressure and variance at x=r=2H². Nineteen classical sensitivity integrations resolve a positive metric-junction derivative and provide local shell response coefficients.

The archive preserves mathematical derivations, code, numerical data, local and public registration provenance, negative controls, an internal scientific review and literature provenance. The independent review aggregator's original trace-acceptance omission and its passing post-run audit are disclosed, as is a corrected sensitivity symbolic-verifier failure. Separate AI-assisted implementations and review are internal cross-checks, not external peer review.

No physical mass law or gravitational coupling is selected. This checkpoint does not solve quantum-corrected shell backreaction, construct a causal in-in evolution kernel, or establish particle production, heating, thermalization or a hot Big Bang. Analytic tail bounds and numerical agreement do not constitute a global certified arithmetic enclosure. Reproduction requires the pinned inherited inputs in a full HDBLAST repository checkout; the checkpoint ZIP alone is not self-contained.
